title: The method §0–§11 (Design's working rules)
what: §0 'Read everything before making anything … Nothing about the brief caused that. Not reading did.' (all-shaktis-data.js authoritative). §1 'Mechanism, never mood … When a direction arrives as an adjective, convert it to a mechanism out loud and get that confirmed before building.' (Turrell). §2 'Never show the first attempt … push to V2 silently, push to V3 silently'. §3 'Say the plan in plain words, and distrust your own vocabulary … The brief was more radical than the build.' §4 'Fix the rule, not the instance'. §5 'No cuts, only travel … if the user has to choose from a list, the design isn't finished.' §6 'One engine with N tunings, never N artefacts … the mechanism is hers; the light, material and geometry come from her world.' §7 'Build from the real data, degrade gracefully, never invent canon … The gaps are information.' §8 'Verify what the eye can't reach — and verify backwards' (bump ?v=; Object3D.position read-only; clamp gl_PointSize). §9 'Time is elapsed, never device-tied … a high-water mark, not a live reading'. §10 'Never measure it out loud … Depth is felt — a ceremony that runs quicker, a room that opens further along, a light already lit when you arrive.' §11 'Register decisions where they survive the conversation … Anything that lives only in a message is already lost.' Shape: Read → Convert → Concept three passes → Judge → Build engine → Verify by probe → Write decisions. 'Ask when the answer changes what gets built and cannot be derived from the files.'
